---
title: "Budget and Revenue"
---

This page explores the relationship between film production budgets and box office revenue. 

::: {#cell-fig-budget-revenue .cell execution_count=1}
``` {.python .cell-code}
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")

plt.figure(figsize=(7, 5))
plt.scatter(films["budget_musd"], films["revenue_musd"], alpha=0.5)
plt.xlabel("Budget")
plt.ylabel("Revenue")
plt.title("Budget vs. Revenue")
plt.show()
```
